items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There's a fellow called Zimmerman, who is not related to Roy. ... Did you ever know him... [INTERVIEWEE] No, I don't believe it.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's right. They're quite a good bit of men. That names have never been known.
There's a fellow called Zimmerman, who is not related to Roy. He's supposed to have played Ragtime back around, Urban Laclaze time. Uh-huh. Did you ever know him, Tom or Tony? I can't remember.
